tools.name: Panel
tools.description: Gallup World Poll country-year panel for up to 10 countries (ISO3) from the dashboard country view: annual life ladder, three-year average, GDP per capita, social support, healthy life expectancy, freedom, generosity, corruption, positive/negative affect, benevolence and inequality, 2005 onwards. Only the current vintage is served; edition, if given, must match it.

options.name: countries
options.about: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes (XKX Kosovo, TWN Taiwan, HKG Hong Kong).

options.name: edition
options.about: Optional pin; must equal the dashboard's current vintage (latest data year + 1) or the call fails with not_found.

options.name: variables
options.about: Subset of variables to include; life_ladder is always included. Omit for all.

response.about: Gallup World Poll country-year panel for up to 10 countries (ISO3) from the dashboard country view: annual life ladder, three-year average, GDP per capita, social support, healthy life expectancy, freedom, generosity, corruption, positive/negative affect, benevolence and inequality, 2005 onwards. Only the current vintage is served; edition, if given, must match it.

tools.name: Rankings
tools.description: One page of a World Happiness Report edition's ranking table (three-year average Cantril ladder score and rank) with the six explanatory-factor shares and raw factor levels from the dashboard country view. edition N reads dashboard data year N-1. Paginate with next_cursor; filter to ISO3 codes with countries.

options.name: countries
options.about: Optional ISO3 filter; unranked codes are reported in warnings.

options.name: cursor
options.about: next_cursor from the previous page; encodes the edition. Pattern: ^v1:[0-9]{4}:[0-9]{1,4}$.

options.name: edition
options.about: Report year (2013-2026 published). Required unless cursor is given.

options.name: include_factors
options.about: false skips the per-country detail calls (faster; explained_by and factors are null).

response.about: One page of a World Happiness Report edition's ranking table (three-year average Cantril ladder score and rank) with the six explanatory-factor shares and raw factor levels from the dashboard country view. edition N reads dashboard data year N-1. Paginate with next_cursor; filter to ISO3 codes with countries.
